title: FBI-UAP-D030, FD-302, “Large Triangle with Red Lights,” 2023
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview report regarding a UAP sighting in Colorado Springs, containing heavy redactions of personal names and specific locations.

incidents.summary: A witness observed a large, solid black triangular object with red lights at each corner emerging from a dark-gray cloud, exhibiting instantaneous acceleration and unusual banking maneuvers.
incidents.quote: saw a constant, diffuse red light on the bottom front point of a solid black triangular shaped object
